references.text: A parallel law forbidding sexual relations with a father's sister and a mother's sister describes the same prohibition against uncovering nakedness among close relatives
A general principle of not uncovering nakedness of anyone who is a close relative, which forms the basis for the specific prohibitions
The same context with prohibitions against incestuous relationships and the use of the phrase 'they shall bear their iniquity' as punishment
A closely related verse dealing with the prohibition against sexual relations with an uncle's wife, with similar punitive language about bearing one's iniquity
Ezekiel condemns the same type of incestuous acts as abominable sins in Israel
